VoiceCmd: Sample code to demonstrate Fonix speech recognition on the Win32.

To try out speech recognition on the Win32, you can do the following:

   1. Double-click "Examples\data\VoiceCmd\Data\vocabBuilderWin32.bat"
      This file creates the required recognition files as well as copies
      the files into a c:\data directory referenced in the program.
   2. Fix the project to include the common files included in the DXSDK
      that are used by the VoiceCmd project. They are included in the 
      project in the Common folder.  You will also need to make sure that 
      the include and library files are referenced correctly.
   3. Compile and run "VoiceCmd" in the VoiceCmd directory or in the debuger.
      


For more information, see Fonix\Docs\GamersASR.doc.
